entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: Substate entered when no 5G cell can be selected after intensive search failure. Cells are searched at low rhythm and no 5GS services are offered.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: Previous substate from which 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE is entered after search failure.

entities.name: No 5G cell available
entities.description: Condition where no 5G cell can be selected after intensive search.

entities.name: No 5GS services offered
entities.description: Property indicating that no 5GS services are available in this substate.

entities.name: Low rhythm cell search
entities.description: Property indicating cells are searched at a low rhythm in this substate.

relations.description: Condition of no 5G cell available after intensive search establishes entry into NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substate.
Transition from PLMN-SEARCH substate to NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substate after search failure.
NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substate establishes that no 5GS services are offered.
NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substate establishes that cells are searched at low rhythm.
